learning_outcomes.text: Students know various definitions of the term assistance system.
Students know various forms of assistance systems such as voice assistants, assistance systems for decision support.
Students know the history of voice assistants.
Students know the basics of game and decision theory.
Students can plan a dialogue for a voice assistant, using aspects of "Conversational Design".
Students can develop a decision support system, including planning, algorithm development and implementation of a user interface.

syllabus_topics: Basics of game and decision theory
Graphical representation of data and calculation results of machine learning methods
Development of a decision assistant including user interface
